entity_geography.text: ne Roanne Palais du Commerce - Place de la Bourse 69002 LYON 1.2 - Mode de passation La procédure de passation utilisée est l'appel d'offres ouvert. Elle est soumise aux dispositions des articles L. 2124-2, R. 2124-2 1° et R. 2161-2 à R. 2161-5 du Code de la commande publique. 1.3 - Type et forme de contrat Les lots 1 à 5 sont des accords-cadres à bons de commande, conclus avec un montant maximum fixé pour chaque lot, en application des articles L. 2125-1 1°, R. 2162-1 à R. 2162-6, R. 2162-13 et R. 2162-14 du Code de la commande publique. Ils donnent lieu à l'émission de bons de commande. Chaque accord-cadre sera attribué à un seul opérateur économique. Le lot 6 n'est pas exécuté par bons de commande et ne donne lieu à aucun paiement de la CCI. Le titulaire se rémunère sur les recettes publicitaires qu'il facture et encaisse auprès des annonceurs, et reverse à la CCI une redevance dans les conditions fixées au CCP. La valeur estimée du lot 6, correspondant au chiffre d'affaires publicitaire prévisionnel sur la durée maximale du contrat, est de 180 000 € HT. All hazards shall be eliminated or reduced to the lowest risk level practical using methods in the following order of precedence: design; incorporation of safety devices; incorporation of warning devices; technical manual procedures; and New Equipment Training (NET) and sustainment training. Catastrophic and critical hazards (as defined in MIL-STD-882) shall not rely solely on warnings, cautions, or procedures/training for control of risk. Electrical Safety Electrical materials and equipment shall be selected, applied, installed and protected in accordance with NFPA 70. Audible warning signals shall be distinguishable from other sounds under normal operating conditions. Visual signals shall be readily visible and easily recognized. deliverables_scope.text: ===== FILE: files/ACC-APG_Digital_IF_Call_for_Solutions_12Nov2026_Amendmnt_0002.docx ===== Capability Program Executive Command and Control Information Network (CPE C2IN) Call for Solutions (CfS) for Product Manager Wideband Enterprise Satellite Systems (PdM WESS) Commercial Digital Intermediate Frequency Subsystem (DIFS) under the Army Open Solicitation (AOS) Commercial Solutions Opening (CSO) SECTION 1 - INTRODUCTION BACKGROUND Product Manager Wideband Enterprise Satellite Systems (PdM WESS) is seeking solutions for a Commercial-Off-The-Shelf (COTS) Digital Intermediate Frequency (IF) system to satisfy the requirements for Increment 1 of this modernization effort. The current legacy analog infrastructure limits scalability, resilience, and interoperability. Under this Call for Solutions, the selected vendor will deliver, integrate, install, and acceptance-test a flexible, open-standard, modular Digital IF solution across up to twenty (20) worldwide satellite communications (SATCOM) teleport sites. Increment 1 will establish a fully operational baseline designed to support subsequent capability upgrades and integrations in future fiscal years. SECTION 2 – REQUIREMENT DESCRIPTION PROBLEM STATEMENT Area of Interest: Modular Digital Intermediate Frequency Solu

quires an open-standard Digital IF architecture. However, before committing to a full-scale global deployment, the DoW must validate the operation, interoperability, security, and performance of these modular commercial solutions in a rigorous representative environment. Technical Objective & Scope The DoW seeks a commercial solution for an Increment 1 Digital IF capability set built on a flexible, open standard (e.g., Digital Intermediate Frequency Interoperability compliant), modular architecture. The selected solution will undergo standard site acceptance testing and operational verification to confirm compliance with contract performance requirements and site compatibility. Upon successful acceptance, this operational configuration will serve as the standardized baseline for deployment and installation across up to twenty (20) worldwide SATCOM teleport sites. Mission Impact Successful validation and deployment of this flexible open-standard Digital IF architecture will directly enhance warfighter lethality and survivability by delivering a highly resilient, agile, and survivable GEO-SATCOM capability which rapidly adapts to contested/congested environments. Comparative evaluation is NOT a low price technically acceptable (LPTA) or trade-off process. To meet these ESR bunch injection schemes and requirements, an array of stripline-based kickers, individually fed by high voltage (HV) pulse signals of up to +/-30 kV, will be installed in the ESR. The required deflection angle is in the range 1- 1.5 mrad, for the individual stripline kicker we target a deflection angle of ~125 µrad @ 18 GeV, assuming +/-27 kV pulse supply voltage between the kicker electrodes. To keep the losses of the stored beam low, a ~15 σ distance between the stored beam and the injection septa in the ESR must be maintained, which translates into a minimum physical aperture of 30 mm diameter for the stripline kickers.
